analyst.summary: Welspun Living, a leading Indian home-textiles exporter (bed and bath linens, rugs, and a newer flooring business), had a difficult FY26: sales fell about 11% and profit fell about 67% as margins compressed sharply, with one quarter's results distorted further by an unusually high tax rate. Debt has come down modestly. The stock currently trades at a rich earnings multiple given how depressed current profitability is. We rate it a Hold, but flag this as one of the weaker fundamental trends we reviewed this round.
